definitions.yards: Dead-ball center relative to the artificial starting point; not official credited fumble yards.
definitions.scenario: Isolated carrier at +8 yards, 0.75/2/4 yards from sideline, velocity (6, ±1); LB head-on +7 yards, boundary force +5, glancing hit +2 after conversion, or clean -10. All other bodies parked/down. Controlled anatomy, not an NFL rate target.
